title: Jev inside the review orchestrator: severity calibration, duplicate merge, verifier queue order

AC1.note: src/commands/review-jev-triage.ts jevTriageGateRefusal(): opt-in check (review.jev.triage) then credential check, both before any read/network call; refusal-path tests pass in review-jev-triage-cli.test.ts and jev-triage-command.test.ts.

AC2.note: src/review/jev-triage.ts severityCheckQuestion asks the canonical trigger+outcome noul per blocker/major finding; synthesizeTriageAnnotations records {p, flagged} with flagged=p<0.4 and never mutates severity. Live check on 327-r01: 8/8 scored, 0 flagged, all p 0.77-0.83.

AC3.note: buildMergeCandidatePairs gates on shared file / overlapping line window / overlapping quote, capped at MAX_MERGE_CANDIDATE_PAIRS=200; one noul per pair, output as merge_candidates with p, never merged. Live check produced 9 pairs (MAX_MERGE_CANDIDATE_PAIRS untouched); hand-labelled in the flow journal.

AC4.note: verifyOrderQuestion asks one noul per finding; synthesizeTriageAnnotations sorts scored items ascending p (lowest plausibility first), unscored appended last; purely a queue order, never a skip. Live check: verify_order lowest at F-007/F-009 p=0.30.

AC5.note: Redaction: every state/question string passes through redactSensitiveText (src/security/service.ts) in severityCheckState/mergeCandidateState/verifyOrderState; redaction covered by a dedicated test in review-jev-triage-cli.test.ts. Batching: TRIAGE_TOKEN_BUDGET*0.4, MAX_ITEMS_PER_BATCH=3, split-retry-once mirrored from review-jev-contract.ts's attemptBatch, covered by 3 max_tokens_exceeded tests. --max-calls caps items and reports budget.itemsSkipped, tested.

AC6.note: review-orchestrator/SKILL.md: Step 9b line added between Step 9/Step 10 in the Workflow block; net line count unchanged (compensating merge of two Job Context Awareness bullets) — wc -l confirms 1723 for both the src/gdskills/bundled and .metaproject/skills copies, diff confirms byte-identical. SKILL.detail.md gained a full '## jev-triage' section, synced identically to both copies. bundled-eval.test.ts (60 tests, including the ceiling-equality test) passes.

AC7.note: src/tui/jev-triage-command.ts /triage: resolveLatestReviewPackage scans .metaproject/flows/*/reviews/*/findings.json by mtime; runJevTriageForShell gates then triages; wired into tui-shell.ts, agent-commands.ts, help-groups.ts (mirrors /contract exactly). jev-triage-command.test.ts (8 tests) and agent-commands.test.ts (36 tests) pass.

AC8.note: docs/docs/cli-reference.md: subcommand table row + full '### review jev-triage' section with flags table. src/standard/help-groups.ts: /triage slash entry. docs/docs/commands-by-task.md regenerated via scripts/generate-commands-by-task.ts (test passes). keryx review USAGE text in src/commands/review.ts updated.

AC9.note: Hermetic tests: src/review/jev-triage.test.ts (23, pure core), src/commands/review-jev-triage-cli.test.ts (12, CLI+fixtures+injected env, opt-in-off and no-credential paths covered, redaction covered), src/tui/jev-triage-command.test.ts (8). bun run typecheck: clean. bun run lint: clean. bun ./scripts/opentui-tests-no-skips.ts src/tui: 1318 pass/0 fail/0 skipped. No test reads OPENROUTER_API_KEY from the machine.

AC10.note: Live: env -u OPENROUTER_API_KEY keryx review jev-triage --report .metaproject/flows/327-*/reviews/327-r01 --max-calls 25 --json against the saved OpenRouter key (never printed). 9 Jev calls total (well under ~40), cost $0.00032. 8 blocker/major findings scored: severity_check all p 0.77-0.83, 0 flagged (correct — all 8 are genuine trigger+outcome majors/blockers). 9 merge_candidates found by shared file; hand-labelled: MRG2 F-001<->F-009 p=0.61 and MRG3 F-002<->F-003 p=0.58 are NOT true duplicates (different root causes sharing a file) — Jev leans a bit high on same-file pairs; MRG1 F-001<->F-006 p=0.21 and MRG9 F-006<->F-009 p=0.24 correctly scored low (different specific defects). verify_order lowest-first: F-007/F-009 (p=0.30) ahead of F-010 (p=0.46). Reported in full in the PR description and flow journal.
